chunks: ʿUbaydullāh ibn ʿAlī al-Ḥalabī asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the menstruating woman, what is permissible for her husband from her. He said:
“She should wrap herself with an izār down to the knees and leave her navel uncovered; then for him is what is above the izār.”

key_terms.بِإِزَارٍ: with an izār, a covering cloth
key_terms.تَتَّزِرُ: she wraps herself with a waistcloth

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his menstruating wife according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning what is permissible between a husband and his menstruating wife. It specifies a physical boundary marked by the izār, indicating permissibility for what is above it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.204 - Ubaidullah ibn Ali Al-Halabi asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about what is permissible for a husband with regard to his menstruating wife.
Imam (as) said:
'She should cover herself with a cloth (izar) from her navel to her knees, and he may have what is above the izar.'.
